run_steps.name: run-01-cd
run_steps.cmd: cd /work && python -m py_compile cmsfit.py test_cmsfit.py > /out/compile.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; cat /out/compile.txt; exit $rc

run_steps.name: run-02-cd
run_steps.cmd: cd /work && OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 python -m unittest -v test_cmsfit > /out/tests.txt 2>&1; echo $? > /out/tests_rc.txt; tail -n 60 /out/tests.txt; exit 0

run_steps.name: run-03-cd
run_steps.cmd: cd /work && sha256sum cmsfit.py test_cmsfit.py AMENDMENT-CMSTOPO-0.1.1.md | tee /out/sha256.txt && pip freeze > /out/versions.txt

run_steps.name: run-04-cd
run_steps.cmd: cd /work && OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 timeout 3000 python cmsfit.py --mode selftest --out-dir /out > /out/run.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; grep -E '^CMSFIT_' /out/run.txt | cut -c1-600; tail -n 20 /out/run.txt; exit $rc
